acceptance: A journey lands a stack whose commits each passed the gate
A stack with one unreviewed commit is refused, and the text names that commit
fix: Design first. Decide whether a chain of per-commit records covers a whole change when each commit's base is the previous commit, and what a rebase with hand-resolved conflicts needs.

intake_override.reason: found during the merging component work, 2026-11-05

summary: On 2026-11-06 evolve integration record-pr --reviewed refused PR 1306: no review record for its whole change. Each of its three commits passed its seats. A seat over the 293 KB whole diff is costly and likely to stall, so the PR went by the manual batch path.
title: The console train needs one review of a whole PR, so a reviewed stack cannot ride it
